text: Hello boys and girls, nice to see you again.Welcome to Sophie's class.In today's lesson, we are going to listen to several conversations and learn how to make apologies and excuses.Besides, we will apologize and make excuses based on the given situations.Please get your student's book and worksheet ready.Pancy looks worried now.Let's listen to Pancy and answer the following questions.It's Friday today and all the editors need to hand in our rewritten articles.However, my mom is ill these days and I am busy taking care of her.So I don't have time to rewrite the article.Now Joyce is calling me.What shall I do?Can you help me?What should Pancy do?Pancy should make an apology to Joyce for not finishing the article.What may Pancy tell Joyce?She may tell Joyce she is sorry and she is so busy taking care of her mom that she can't rewrite the article on time.Then please think about the following questions.Why do people usually make an apology?People usually make an apology for doing something wrong or causing a problem.What do people expect when they make an apology?They expect others to forgive them.What else do people sometimes do to make a sincere apology?They sometimes give an excuse.An excuse is a reason people sometimes give for doing something bad.Now listen to the conversation and answer the following questions.Please take out your worksheet and finish task one.Well, I've just got here myself, so I wasn't waiting for long.And Tony, I'm terribly sorry, but I've forgotten to bring the tickets with me.How could you do that?It's my memory.It's so bad these days.I keep forgetting things.Then you'd better do something about it, hadn't you?Have you got the answers?Let's check.What was the possible relationship between the two speakers?They were probably friends.Who made apologies and excuses?Good, Arthur.Why did he make apologies?Because he was late and he didn't bring the tickets with him.Now let's move on to task two.Listen to the conversation again and answer the following questions.What did Arthur say to apologize?Right, the first time he said, sorry, I'm late.And the second time he said, I'm terribly sorry.Which apology was stronger?Yes, the second one.In fact, sorry on its own is quite casual.Terribly, very, and awfully are commonly used to increase the degree of apology.Did Tony accept Arthur's apologies?Tony accepted the first one, but didn't accept the second.At first, Tony said, that's all right, which shows he accepted Arthur's apology.Now please open your student's book and turn to page 80.Read the conversation after recording, and then think about the steps of making an apology and responding to an apology.Sorry, I'm late, Tony, but the bus broke down and there were no taxis.That's all right, Arthur.I've just got here myself, so I wasn't waiting for long.What did Arthur say to make apologies?Underline Arthur's words in red in your book, and think about the steps of making an apology.Let's start.Athurs said,Sorry, I'm late, I'm terribly sorry, but I've forgotten to bring the tickets with me.So first, he apologized directly and told what was wrong.Then, Arthur said, the bus broke down and there were no taxis.Here, breakdown means stop working, 出故障。After apologizing, he gave excuses.What was the excuse he gave the second time?Now, please underline Tony's words in black in your book, and think about the steps of responding to an apology.The first time he said, that's alright.It means he accepted Arthur's apology.Then he said, I've just got here myself, so I wasn't waiting for long.Why did he say this?Great to offer comfort.And the second time, when Tony rejected 拒绝Arthur's apology, he said, how could you do that?What does it mean?It is a way to express dissatisfaction.In the end, Tony gave Arthur a piece of advice.When we don't want to forgive someone, we will reject his apology, and sometimes give him advice.Think about the following questions.Why did Arthur use a strong apology for the second time?Great, because he forgot to bring the tickets, and this made it impossible for him and Tony to enter the theater.Why did Tony accept Arthur's first apology, but reject the second one?Right, because Arthur's first mistake didn't cause a serious problem.However, because of his second mistake, they couldn't enter the theater.And we can also take a look at the excuses he gave.What's the difference between these two excuses?The first one is about traffic, which can't be controlled by people.However, in his second excuse, he should take the responsibility for his carelessness.Here is tip one.Please remember, sometimes making an excuse can't help you be forgiven.Here are some useful expressions.When we accept apologies, we can use the following expressions.Besides, that's all right.We can also say, it doesn't matter.No problem.Never mind.Forget it.Don't worry about it.It's nothing.Things happen.Accidents happen.Then, if someone is really angry and doesn't want to forgive you, what should you do?Please think about the ways that can help soften someone's anger when you have done something wrong.You can try these ways.Take responsibility.For example, you can say, it's me who broke your vase.Make amends.This is very helpful.You can say, I will buy a new one for you.I will buy a new one for you.And make promises.For example, I promise I will never let it happen again.Complete the conversation with the expressions in the box.Thank you for watching.Have you finished?Peter, can you have a try?Sorry I'm late, Arthur, but I couldn't find your pen.That's alright, Millie.I've got another one.And, Arthur, I'm terribly sorry, but I've broken your e-dictionary.I don't know.It just doesn't work now.Well, you'd better get it repaired, hadn't you?Good job.Thank you.Now, please read the conversation and think about the following questions.laughs check why did Millie apologize because她无法找到阿瑟的笔记,并且毁了他的译语。从我们可以知道的谈话中,阿瑟承认了Millie的第二道道歉。我们可以让阿瑟接受第二道道歉吗?Tom和Anna将想与我们分享她们的想法。与阿瑟的两道道歉相比,让我们知道哪一道道歉比较容易被接受,并提供理由。让我们听听吧!对不起,但我没有打算毁掉你的译语。我不知道为什么现在不成功。我只是放在桌上,然后回到家里看电影。回到家后,我发现有什么问题。我已经叫了修备店,但店主告诉我,他会尽力去修备。别担心,我会付出所有的费用。我保证,这不会再发生。Kitty,您的看法是什么?我认为Anna的道歉比较容易被接受,因为她不仅道歉,还决定去修备E译语,并做了一个承诺。有两个建议。第一,真心道歉。第二,第三,勇敢地负责。让我们来做一个总结。当我们做错了什么,首先,我们应该真心道歉,如果需要,我们可以做出道歉。但记住,做出道歉,不会永远帮助我们原谅。第二,可能其他人会接受道歉,甚至给我们一些安慰。然而,可能他们会拒绝道歉,甚至给我们一些建议。如果我们的道歉被拒绝,我们应该释放其他人的怒气。之后,可能其他人会改变心理,原谅我们。当然,他们可能会生气,拒绝道歉。我认为,在这种情况下,我们应该给他们一些时间,尽力地做出我们所做的。让我们练习。选择一个情况,并完成谈话,用刚刚学到的表达。请取出你的工作室,然后完成任务三。了解更多在我那里的朋友们方向,订阅我的频道,订阅我的银行和我的企划,订阅我的社交
